description: This file defines a React component called Column used in a Kanban board frontend application. It manages the display and editing of a single Kanban column, including inline title editing, deletion, and rendering related cards.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates the new column title, ensuring it is not empty or unchanged.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Activates editing mode for the column title upon double-click or edit button click.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the new title of the column after inline editing, handling validation, async update, and UI feedback.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles keyboard events in the title input box, triggering save on Enter and cancel on Escape.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets modal state to prompt column deletion confirmation.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs the deletion of the column and shows success feedback.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })

ctags.name: Column
ctags.pattern: /^function Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
